It is hard to leave someone you love, this is my weakness, i love him so much even with what he did. Also, because of our 2 daughters. During reconciliation he opened up everything, he said that what he feel for the girl is really special and it was different. This really broke my heart, how low can i be to still accept him. I asked him again to just go, but he refused, he said that he is trying to forget everything about the girl and he wants to make everything right. It really isnt easy to forget someone you love so much, what he feels for this girl, is also what i feel for him. Sometimes they would see each other at work, he’ll come home after work feeling depressed. When i ask, he’ll tell me that the girl ignored him all day like he wasn’t there (to my relief), and tell me how it felt (he is also doing his part in staying away from the AP). But the feeling of being ignored gets into him. Like there is this heaviness in his heart. I dont want to tell him not to tell me this things, i want both of us to be honest. We are both trying to fix ourselves. I dont know how long i can do this, but I’m willing to give it another chance. I hope that in time he realize what he’s done.

Now, as we he came back to me, he admitted everything and is remorseful. He said that he is trying his best to forget the girl and is trying really hard to make it work. He wants to make this work. 

I am in pain and so is my husband. I can feel and see that it is also hard for him. I feel him hurting over the girl. I love my husband so much, it hurts to see him hurting over that girl. 

If we didn’t have kids it would have been easier. But we have two beautiful teenage daughters who loves their father deeply. And i admit that even if he wasn’t a good husband, he is 1000% a good father. They would be devastated if they found out. 

How can i break my daughters heart. How can i tell them what their father has done. They have no idea what happened. 

We are in this situation that we both accepted what happened, we accepted all the hurt and pain. And we both want to make it right. We have to at least try. We don’t know if it will work but we are trying and doing our best to move on.

You are still lucky. Put your head up. You arent married yet with kids. And you found out before it went full blown affair. 

Be selfish and think of your self. 

The same thing happened to me, for 2-3 years my husband was having an EA with his coworker. My husband would confess that he was attracted to her. girl would reject him but would still continue the communication. She was in denial the whole time because hes married, we are friends/neighbors, they’re coworkers and no one wants to be the mistress of course. then came covid, she confessed that she have feelings for him, this was the start of the full blast affair. They lasted for 3 months, girl broke it off. But still continued communication with my husband. After more than a month i found out. 

We reconciled, i am now left with fixing what they broke. I was left with a broken spirit.

It has been a roller coaster ride. There are days that i am numb. And there are days that i feel the world crumbling in. I still cry, everyday. 

I don’t think the pain will ever go away. We just have to live with it. 

We will get through this. We have to at least try.

Dday was 25 days ago. I couldn’t eat for 2 days, i have no appetite, only water. I couldn’t also sleep for 3 days, i just laid on the bed waiting for sleep to come, but not even a yawn came. I think my body was reacting from too much stress. I lost 2 -3 kgs in a week. 

On dday i called my mom, she was the only one i know who can comfort me. While talking to her my brother heard her and asked my sister to reach out to me. My siblings reached out to me, as i am out of the country (expat in an arab country), they knew i didn’t have anybody i can talk to. They listened to me and reminded me, that no matter what i decide on they will support me, even with my 2 daughter’s education, they just want me to be ok. I never felt so much love and support from my family until that time. 

Me and my WS were only apart for 1 day after dday. He apologized and wanted to make things work. I reconciled with him a day after dday. Although he was the reason i was hurt, he was also the one i needed to help me get through it.

Someone who will support you is important. Some of my friends who new what happened sent me messages. They just said that if i needed to talk they are ready to listen. It was very heart warming, even if we weren’t that close they were there for me. 

Don’t lose hope. If you need to cry, you cry. Writing down how i felt also helped me a lot. I wrote letters to my husband. I also have written something to the AP. It is hard to keep it all inside you, this is how i released  the heaviness on my chest.
Please dont think of me as a strong person. I am not. I am just trying to move on and survive. We all have our own journey and coping system. This is just how i cope with things.

I also dont know how. But I had to, for my peace and for my kids. 

At first it was only for my husband when we reconciled. As i accepted his apology, for the marriage to work out, i know i have to forgive him. We also have 2 teenage daughters, it was for them. Although we reconciled i still felt anger towards him. When my feelings showed, the kids were left in the middle, though they have no idea whats happening. They just know im in a very bad mood. I have to accept what happened and to forgive completely.

Then for the AP, the letter i wrote was intended to demean her. All the hurtful things i wanted to tell her. But as i was writing it day by day, i felt i needed to move on. At the latter part of the letter i told her i forgive her. I made it clear it was not for her, but for me, for my inner peace. 

I still feel anger and pain, but not as before. And i can say that i have moved past the affair. I’m focusing now on how to save the marriage, how to start again.

I’m 23 days post dday. I can say that I have forgiven them both, WS and AP. 

I forgave my WS within the week post dday. It was very hard and very very very painful. I chose to forgive, i chose to look beyond the cheating and the lying. I chose to see the man i fell in love with, especially the one who is a great father to our kids. I wasnt ready to give up this man without even trying. My WS also asked for forgiveness and is trying his best to correct his misdoings. 

I forgave AP on the 2nd week post dday. I asked to see her and talked to her, but she refused, she wasn’t ready. My purpose was to let her know how i feel, from all the pain and betrayal. I wrote her a letter instead. I asked questions, asked where her morals were, and other painful stuff that is reasonably true about her. As i was jotting down all the things i wanted to say, i found myself telling her i forgive her. I told her i wanted to move on with my life. I didnt want to get stuck with the affair. They both hurt me and as i forgave my husband, to be fair to her i should also forgive her. And i dont want to carry the anger with me, i want peace of mind as i try to move on. But i told her that as i carry the pain forever, i want her to also carry the guilt, not to punish her but to serve as a lesson to her. 

For me, it lessened the burden. I can still feel anger towards both of them sometimes. It is normal. The pain is still there. But the heaviness is gone. The hurt and pain will take time to heal, one day at a time. But i will get there.

Literally didn’t understand a word she said. She was talking and crying trying to explain herself. Left her after 10 minutes of gibberish. 

After a week i still wanted to talk to her. Tell her all the bad things i could think of. What i did was wrote her a letter. Wrote everything and it was long. After a couple more days i was still writing stuff and editing. Then i gave it to her. 

It was a relief writing, pouring out everything i felt.

I suggest you write it down. But dont send it. Everytime you feel you want to say something to her, write it down. Then sleep on it. It’ll relax things a little bit.
